_comment: Made by tools/gen_galaxy_picture_cases.py from the desktop's REAL jarvis-desktop/src/galaxy-view.js (orderedEntities, buildEntityGraph) and jarvis-desktop/src/galaxy-presets.js (layoutZenRing and every look in BUILT_PRESETS). Do not edit by hand.
_contract: Positions are the desktop's layout units; the phone's fit() scales them to its canvas. 48 is the phone's cap, applied before the links: a dropped name gets no dot and no link. Each case's `looks` holds that look's own positions for the SAME names, in the same order - so GalaxyLayouts.kt's port of each look is checked against the desktop's numbers, and a look missing from the phone is a test that fails naming it.
